criteria.acceptance: Enhancement shows original and proposed prompt plus selected context; user can accept/edit/reject before dispatch.
README images are actual current app captures with measured dimensions, build/version/time/hash and no fixture/native scope confusion.
criteria.verification: Read image dimensions and hash, packaged UI observation receipt

criteria.acceptance: Visible and keyboard-reachable controls have precondition/action/expected state/persistence/failure entries and direct tested evidence.
Target machine reports startup p95<=1500ms, input p95<=16ms and idle working set<=350MB or retains a measured failed criterion with fix plan.
criteria.verification: At least30 startup/input samples and environment-stamped memory receipt

criteria.acceptance: Supported formats, provider protocols, models, tools and domain workflows report exact tested counts and named missing cases.
criteria.verification: Catalog-to-test traceability audit; no universal unsupported claim

criteria.acceptance: README states what Omnia does, why it exists, setup/architecture, current evidence, limitations and current real screenshots.
criteria.verification: Clean-profile setup and README link/image review

criteria.acceptance: Commit SHA, remote branch, version tag and release artifact hashes are checked after push; milestone preserves remaining criteria.
